metadata.title: Apple Stock: Why It’s Dodging the AI Selloff<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Apple Might Be About to Become an AI Stock—but It’s Still Dodging the Tech Selloff
Apple may well be exploring mounting a challenge to Meta Platforms’ Muse personal artificial-intelligence agent—but investors still don’t see the iPhone maker as an AI stock. That’s a good thing right now.
